g.text: Native route scores and observed exploration yield
Two parent layouts, each evaluated with left and right object-placement swaps
Δ = lower-ID route minus higher-ID route. O/R = planned outbound / reserved return actions. Paid = actual action checkpoint.
† Gallery pair 0–1 is compared at paid action 58 using neutral-policy continuation for the shorter route. Other rows compare target arrival.
G: neutral geometry · S: correct category · X: swapped category. Shaded bands show practical ties (±0.05 m² and ±0.10 percentage points).
